nodes.title: INTRO
widgets_values:
## What-Are-Marks

This workflow removes watermarks from images, but can also be used as a general inpainting/outpainting workflow, as well as upscaler.

- **[Demo Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NiSGuVBQaUU)**

## GROUPS
---
**Transform**

- Resize: fix stretched images (toggle)
- Rotate: fix rotated images (toggle)
- Crop: remove excessive empty space (toggle)
- Outpaint: fix excessive cropping (toggle)

**Mask**

- SAM3: prompt for a mask (toggle)
- Load: import an image mask (toggle)
- Draw: use the mask editor

**Inpaint**

- FLUX.1 Fill: usually doesn't need a prompt and just uses context.
- Fill Mask: On: fills the mask with surrounding colors. Off: denoise the original image (Inpaint Nodes)

**Upscale**

- SVR2: upscale the image by the longest edge (SeedVR2)

**Save**

- Save the image from the last active group

## MODELS
---
**Checkpoints -** [sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/resolve/main/checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors)

**Diffusion Models -** [flux1-fill-dev.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux1-dev/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/flux1-fill-dev.safetensors)

**Text Encoders -** [clip_l.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/clip_l.safetensors), [t5xxl_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/resolve/main/t5xxl_fp16.safetensors)

**VAE -** [ae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lumina_Image_2.0_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 checkpoints/
│   │      └── sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── flux1-fill-dev.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── clip_l.safetensors
│   │      └── t5xxl_fp16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│          └── ae.safetensors

```

## CUSTOM NODES
---
**rgthree** - [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)

**Impact** - [ComfyUI-Impact-Pack](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack)

**Inpaint** - [comfyui-inpaint-nodes](https://github.com/Acly/comfyui-inpaint-nodes) (used once)

**SVR2** - [ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler](https://github.com/numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler) (used once)

nodes.title: HELP
widgets_values:
• Transformations are applied from top to bottom; all of them can be toggled on/off

1) Resize: fix stretched images

• Width/Height: leaving either at 0 scales the image proportionally

2) Rotate:

• Rotation: degrees to rotate

2) Crop:

• Left/Right/Top/Bottom: the pixels to crop from each side

3) Outpaint: uses FLUX.1 Fill

• Resize Outpaint: resize the image before outpainting and return it to original size after; helps balance quality/speed

• Megapixels: resize resolution

• Ksampler Settings: adjust as needed

• Left/Right/Top/Bottom: the pixels to outpaint on each side

• Blend: the pixels to blend between the original image and outpaint; grows toward the original

nodes.title: HELP
widgets_values:
This group follows this priority:

1) SAM3: prompt for everything you want masked

2) Load Mask: must be pure green (0,255,0) mask on transparent background and same size as image

3) Draw Mask (default): right-click the load image node to open the mask editor and draw

• Resize Inpaint: resize the image before inpainting and return it to original size after; helps balance quality/speed

• Megapixels: resize resolution

• Grow/Blur: applies to all masks

• Taper Corners: round off mask corners when growing the mask

• Pad Left/Top: applies the 16 pixel padding correction to the left (instead of right) or the top (instead of bottom)

•SAM Threshold: detection threshold

•SAM Iterations: refines detection

nodes.title: HELP
widgets_values:
• This group inpaints the mask created in the mask group; running it without a mask will error

• Ksampler Settings: adjust as needed

• Fill Mask: fills the masked area before inpainting; leaving it off denoises the original image instead

• Fill Method: algorithm to fill the mask (pro tip: denoise at 0% to see the fill ;))

nodes.title: NOTES
widgets_values:
• SeedVR2 might keep blurriness if it thinks it's part of the image. Downscaling a blurry photo before running it through SVR2 can add more detail because the model will no longer interpret it as a blurry photo, but a small photo

• SAM Example Prompts:
watermark, overlay, timestamp
logo, brand, signature, url
red sign, white text, yellow spike

nodes.title: NOTES
widgets_values:
• Prompting is usually optional (or bad) as Flux Fill uses the surrounding context

• Inpainting at >2MP can be slow and give worse results; Flux is trained for 1MP which can give higher quality while being faster

• If your mask covers most of the image, Flux Fill won't have enough context and the inpaint will suck

• If a seam is visible, increasing the blur will blend better but you may need to grow the mask to compensate

• Flux Fill might add a watermark depending on if the composition is off-balance. Its training data includes watermarks so it might think empty space = watermark. To prevent it from adding one, crop the empty space just enough
